title: Data Analyst
job_description:
Data Analyst - Fabrikam Stores (fictional company), Remote

About the role
Fabrikam Stores is hiring a Data Analyst to support our e-commerce and retail teams.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau for sales, marketing and operations.
- Write SQL to pull and transform data from our Snowflake warehouse.
- Run A/B test analysis for website changes and report results to stakeholders.
- Automate recurring reports with Python.
- Present findings clearly to non-technical managers.

Requirements
- 2+ years of experience as a data or business analyst.
- Strong SQL skills.
- Experience with Tableau or a similar BI tool.
- Python for data work (pandas).
- Understanding of A/B testing and basic statistics.
- Nice to have: Snowflake, dbt, retail or e-commerce experience.

# Alex Sample
Data Analyst | Example City | alex@example.com | 000-000-0000

## Professional Summary
Data Analyst with 3 years of experience turning retail sales data into dashboards and reports for managers and business teams.
Strong in SQL (PostgreSQL), Python (pandas) and BI dashboards (Power BI), with a track record of streamlining recurring reporting.
BSc in Statistics, bringing a solid grounding in statistical analysis to sales, marketing and operations questions.

## Key Skills
- **Data & SQL:** SQL, PostgreSQL, data cleaning, data transformation, joining datasets
- **Python:** Python, pandas, report preparation workflows
- **BI & Reporting:** Power BI, dashboards, Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), recurring reports
- **Analysis:** Statistics, sales analysis, returns and stock-level tracking, ad-hoc analysis
- **Domain:** Retail sales data, reporting for store managers, finance and marketing stakeholders

## Experience

**Data Analyst** | Northwind Retail | 2023 - Present
- Built and maintain weekly sales dashboards in Power BI used by 12 store managers to track store performance.
- Write SQL queries in PostgreSQL to pull and track sales, returns and stock levels.
- Clean and join data with Python (pandas), cutting report preparation time from 6 hours to 1 hour.

**Junior Analyst** | Contoso Shop | 2021 - 2023
- Maintained Excel reports for the finance team using pivot tables and VLOOKUP.
- Answered ad-hoc data questions from the marketing team, turning requests into clear answers.

## Education
**BSc Statistics** | Example University | 2021
cover_letter:
Dear Fabrikam Stores Hiring Team,

Your Data Analyst opening caught my attention because it sits right where I have spent the last three years: turning retail sales data into dashboards and reports that managers actually use. I would welcome the chance to bring that experience to your e-commerce and retail teams.

At Northwind Retail, I build weekly sales dashboards in Power BI that 12 store managers rely on to follow performance in their stores. Behind those dashboards, I write SQL queries in PostgreSQL to track sales, returns and stock levels. I also clean and join data in Python with pandas, which cut our report preparation time from six hours to one. Your role asks for strong SQL, a BI tool such as Tableau and Python for recurring reports, and that is the core of my daily work. I am confident my Power BI and PostgreSQL experience will carry over quickly to Tableau and Snowflake.

Before Northwind, I spent two years as a Junior Analyst at Contoso Shop, maintaining Excel reports for the finance team and answering ad-hoc data questions from marketing. That role taught me to work out what a non-technical colleague really needs and to give them a clear answer, not just a table of numbers. My BSc in Statistics gives me a solid grounding in the statistical methods behind A/B test analysis, an area I am keen to apply directly to your website experiments.

I would enjoy talking about how I could help Fabrikam's teams make faster, better-informed decisions. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Kind regards,
Alex Sample
